subject: general
question: A man walks from his home to a park at 4 { km/h} and returns along the same route at 6 { km/h} . If the total time taken for the entire trip is 1 { hour} . Find the distance between his home and the park.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the same distance is covered at two different speeds S₁ and S₂, and the total time T is known:

One-way Distance = (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂) × Total Time

Distance = (4 × 6) ÷ (4 + 6) × 1

Distance = 24 ÷ 10 = 2.4 km

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4 km.**
